provenance.source: Budget Ndio Story Verified Partners Registry

partners.name: House of Fiscal Wisdom
partners.role: Institutional Host & Research Secretariat for Project TERRA
partners.description: A Global Commission on Financing Development headquartered in Nairobi, positioning itself as an African institutional alternative to the Bretton Woods architecture.

partners.name: Luminate
partners.role: Funder — Governance, digital rights, and public accountability
partners.description: A global foundation working to ensure that everyone — especially those who are underrepresented — has the information, rights, and power to influence the decisions that affect their lives.

partners.name: CABRI (Collaborative Africa Budget Reform Initiative)
partners.role: Co-production partner on digital PFM and IFMIS country reform briefings
partners.description: An intergovernmental organisation that provides a platform for peer learning and exchange for African ministries of finance and planning.

partners.name: AFRODAD
partners.role: Continental debt scrutiny forum & sovereign debt monitoring partner
partners.description: African Forum and Network on Debt and Development — empowering African citizens to actively participate in sustainable economic development through debt policy scrutiny.

partners.name: TISA Kenya (The Institute for Social Accountability)
partners.role: Partner — Transparency, county devolution tracking, and citizen integrity
partners.description: A civil society initiative dedicated to promoting sound public finance management and citizen oversight in Kenya.

partners.name: Committee on Fiscal Studies (University of Nairobi)
partners.role: Academic research partner on fiscal law, digital economy, and sovereign debt
partners.description: A center of excellence in fiscal law and policy based at the University of Nairobi Faculty of Law.

partners.name: Tax Justice Network (TJN)
partners.role: Partner — Illicit financial flows, tax havens, and multinational corporate tax fairness
partners.description: An independent international network dedicated to researching and advocating for systemic tax justice.

partners.name: Dr. Lyla Latif
partners.role: Principal Investigator (Project TERRA) | Managing Partner, Lai & Latif Advocates
partners.description: Lecturer at University of Nairobi Faculty of Law, Chair of the Committee on Fiscal Studies, and Non-Executive Director at Tax Justice Network. Specialist in tax and tech governance.

partners.name: Prof. Attiya Waris
partners.role: UN Independent Expert on Foreign Debt & Human Rights | Co-Founder House of Fiscal Wisdom
partners.description: Professor of Public Finance Law and leading authority on fiscal sociology, tax justice, and human rights in public spending.

partners.name: Prof. George Wajackoyah
partners.role: AFRODAD Continental Panelist on Sovereign Debt Accountability
partners.description: Key legal commentator speaking on continental sovereign debt frameworks and parliamentary oversight.
